hotspots.plan: Split health/auth/account routes, participant journey routes and authoring routes behind stable handler ports; keep the current envelope and route-level authorization characterization tests green at each extraction.
Separate immutable catalog data, module/session builders and curriculum validation into focused modules without changing public catalog IDs.
Extract participant data loading, journey panels, activity state and accessible form sections into feature components while preserving the browser/API contract.
Split diagnostic evaluation, module evaluation, retention/remediation and personalized-path projections into pure policy modules with invariant tests retained.
Extract account lifecycle, dashboard summaries and invite form state into focused admin feature components with deny-by-default UI behavior preserved.
Split assignment, assessment workflow, feedback and appeal repository commands into bounded repository modules sharing only transaction/security helpers.
Split schema declarations by bounded context and keep the aggregate export stable; migrations and schema snapshot verification must pass after each extraction.
Extract feedback ticket lifecycle, learning assignment transitions and assessment workflow policies into bounded domain modules while preserving immutable state transitions and their invariant tests.
